title: Edison's device to communicate with the dead

tellings.quote: Edison, near the end of his life, actually tried to build a device to communicate with the dead.

plain: Thomas Edison, near the end of his life in the 1920s, tried to build a device for talking with the dead. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. If true, it would mean one of America's great inventors took contact with the dead seriously enough to try to engineer it.
